title: 023 梦魇024 踏上地道的准备多追读
content_zh:
面对卢倩欣赏的目光，许临东有些错愕，“队长，你现在这样，也让我很意外，刚刚你这是......？”
卢倩撩了下耳边发丝，平淡笑道：
“我刚才借着出手做掩饰，已经通知姜队去定位那个阴差的位置。
别小看我们这些队长，在夏国境内，神异司才是序列超凡者的第一大势力，邪会还掀不起太大风浪。”
她话语一顿，坦然道：
“其实早在几天前，姜队就推测，如果城里还有邪会的残党潜伏，一定会盯上我们这批参与过青龙寺任务的人。
所以我和姜队商量过，打算将计就计，把他们引出来彻底解决。”
“啊？”
唐哲和李云帆同时一愣。
唐哲脸色尤其难看，显然意识到自己可能也被盯上了。
“别慌。”
卢倩出声安抚，看向许临东：
“本来这几天，我们一直没找到这些老鼠的踪迹，没想到，今天倒是你给了我们一个惊喜。”
许临东摇摇头，指向门口仍有些发懵的林霄：
“我也是和这位林少起冲突之后，才察觉不对。
之前我接触过阴差的诅咒，还用灶神轿转移过，对这种气息比较敏感。”
卢倩眼中了然，最后那丝疑虑也散了，点头道：“这阴差太狂了，以为留下一道诅咒气息我们就拿他没办法。
但他们能弄到邪异物，司里也有神异物和灵异物作助力。
这会儿姜队估计已经使用神异物出手，把他拿下了。”
她话锋一顿，凝视许临东，神色认真起来：“不过……那阴差最后的话，听起来像是觉得邪异物的子器会盯上你，或者，他们误以为那东西在你手里。

你自己得小心。”
“什么？”
许临东心头一跳，面上仍强作镇定，“邪异物子器怎么可能在我这儿。”
“当然不可能。”
卢倩摇头，“几天前姜队给你们测精气神时，就已经确认过了。
但这些邪会的人可能会瞎猜。”
她语气稍缓，“别担心，只要姜队拿下那阴差，他乱猜的消息也传不出去。
你还是安全的。”
“原来那天姜队检测精气神是为了这个……”
许临东暗惊，“真是水够深的。
而且司里，居然有宝物能直接锁定阴差位置……”
他暗暗松了口气。
邪异物子器确实在他手里，但事关通天塔，这个秘密绝不能暴露。
往后，必须更小心才行。
“卢队，阴差刚才提过王烁……”
唐哲突然提醒。
几人想起这里，脸色微变，李云帆立即就要联系王烁。
content_en:
Facing Lu Qian's appreciative gaze, Xu Lindong was a little stunned, "Captain, you are like this, which surprises me. What did you just do...?"
Lu Qian brushed her hair beside her ears and said with a flat smile:
"I just used my cover-up to inform Captain Jiang to locate the location of the bad news.
Don't underestimate us captains. In the Xia Kingdom, the Department of Mysteries is the largest force for Sequence Transcendents, and the evil society can't make much waves yet. "
She paused and said calmly:
"Actually, a few days ago, Captain Jiang speculated that if there are still remnants of the evil society lurking in the city, they will definitely target those of us who participated in the Qinglong Temple mission.
So Captain Jiang and I discussed it and planned to use the trick to lure them out and solve it completely. "
"Huh?"
Tang Zhe and Li Yunfan were stunned at the same time.
Tang Zhe's face was particularly ugly, and he obviously realized that he might also be targeted.
"Don't panic."
Lu Qian comforted her and looked at Xu Lindong:
"Originally, we haven't found any trace of these mice in the past few days. Unexpectedly, you gave us a surprise today."
Xu Lindong shook his head and pointed to Lin Xiao, who was still a little confused at the door:
"It was only after I had a conflict with Mr. Lin that I realized something was wrong.
I have been exposed to Yinzai's curse before, and I also used the kitchen shrine to transfer it, so I am quite sensitive to this kind of smell. "
Lu Qian's eyes were clear, and her doubts were finally dispelled. She nodded and said: "This conspiracy is so crazy, I thought there was nothing we could do to him if he left a curse aura.
But they can get evil and supernatural objects, and Si Li also has supernatural and supernatural objects to help.
At this time, Team Jiang had probably used a magical weapon to take him down. "
She paused, stared at Xu Lindong, and looked serious: "But... the last words of the Yin Zha sounded like they thought that the evil object's weapon would be targeting you, or they mistakenly thought that the thing was in your hands.
You have to be careful yourself. "
"What?"
Xu Lindong's heart skipped a beat, but he still kept his composure on his face, "How could the evil foreign object device be here with me?"
"Of course not possible."
Lu Qian shook her head, "Captain Jiang already confirmed this when he tested your energy and energy a few days ago.
But people in these sects may make wild guesses. "
She softened her tone slightly and said, "Don't worry, as long as Captain Jiang takes down the evildoer, the news of his random guesses won't spread.
You are still safe. "
"It turns out that Captain Jiang tested his energy and spirit that day for this purpose..."
Xu Lindong was secretly shocked, "The water is really deep.
Moreover, in Si Li, there is actually a treasure that can directly lock the location of Yinsha..."
He secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
The evil foreign object weapon is indeed in his hands, but it is related to the Tower of Babel, and this secret must not be exposed.
In the future, we must be more careful.
"Captain Lu, Yin Chai mentioned Wang Shuo just now..."
Tang Zhe suddenly reminded.
When several people thought of this, their expressions changed slightly, and Li Yunfan immediately contacted Wang Shuo.
